sources.supports: Target BeforeApplying is distinct from target Applying and from source OutputModifier/OutputDamage; names alone do not prove that every stage is necessary in ArkBattle.
Before HP/EP inputs the enemy may gain SP and teleport; actual archived counter buff is not silenceable, so source silence does not establish the proposed counterexample.
Automatic defensive activation is S2. Its current trigger template is Applying6; it must not be described as target Before5 just because it precedes ordinary receiving judgments.
The relic's HP-damage SP gain observes source OutputDamage. This does not reverse its relative order with Tippi's Applying6 trigger when Before5 and source11 are swapped.
Output-stage recalculation can overwrite previously modified damage; reachability of a target-before modification must be established separately.
Enemy default-category device only accepts attacks from adjacent tiles and zeros modifiers from outside. Installed prefab and native targeting are independently checked.
The candle's special damage admission is tied to Entelechia; the candidate pairing with Crow is not an ordinary legal attack.

limits: A finite negative search is not a proof that source output and target before-applying commute for all native content. No game execution or active XLua validation.
